name: tatsulokcoms
description: TATSULOKComs - Real-time communication platform with persistent user accounts

scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:dev: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.postinstall: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
